explanation: Potassium first became elevated on 2026-03-02 at 5.7 mmol/L, occurring with AKI while the patient was on lisinopril. It was 5.0 mmol/L by 2026-03-03. Spironolactone was first given 2026-03-03 10:20 and was not taken before admission. It may relate to the Day 4 recurrence, but it cannot explain the initial onset, whose etiology the record leaves unclear. The answer anchors on the later note and asserts a causal claim the timeline does not allow.
